ModMetaData.name: RimTalk Memories
ModMetaData.author: Ethan
ModMetaData.description:
An overhaul layer for RimTalk. One mod in place of a shelf of companions.
Colonists remember. Memories are scored for weight and for how much they matter right now, and the ones that belong together surface together, so a pawn recalls the raid and the person they lost in it in the same breath.
Around that sits the talking itself: - Prompt presets you can edit, with separate voices by age and by gender. - World and colony lore every pawn speaks from. - Dialogue templates for the beats you want to happen on purpose. - Distance rules for who can hear what, and how far a shout carries. - Length controls for monologues and for conversations. - Whisper, shout and thought as distinct ways of speaking.
Requires RimTalk.
